name: nh3h2o_absorption_precooler_ua
title: Single-stage ammonia-water absorption cycle with a condensate precooler and UA models on the four corners
summary: The Example 9.3 single-stage NH3H2O absorption cycle with condensate precooler, modified as Example 9.3b: the corner temperatures (absorber, condenser, evaporator, desorber) are no longer imposed; each corner is coupled to an external water loop by a UA*LMTD model, which closes the system.
language_features: NH3H2O fluid (any three of T, P, X, Q, H, S, U, V)
PROCEDURE shx (kept; Min() = smaller of two capacity rates)

origin.notes: Example 9.3b (modified ex9_3 with UA models on the four corners) of Herold, Radermacher and Klein, Absorption Chillers and Heat Pumps, CRC Press, 2nd ed., 2015; EES example of F-Chart Software, distributed by the EES-Community/ees-examples repository (commit 5c703d0, folder Case_Study/; the file itself links https://fchartsoftware.com/ees/examples/examples_achp_2015/chapter%209/ex9_3_ua.eez). The .eez companion stores the binary .EES with the solution used as verification reference. Credit: (c) F-Chart Software / S. A. Klein, MIT via EES-Community/ees-examples.

verification.summary: Compared with the EES stored solution of the binary Ex9_3_UA.EES inside ex9_3_ua.eez (compare_solution.py --ees-units, 143 common variables): COP within 1.4 %, heat rates within 3.6 %, pressures within 0.64 %, temperatures within 2.7 %, mass fractions within 3.0 %. Deviations explained by the NH3H2O property backend as for CSL-0360.
